verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that cubic publishes its own MCP server for coding agents to connect to, which is the server role. Nothing shows cubic acting as an MCP client that accepts user-supplied MCP servers and uses their tools. Its Datadog, Jira, Linear, Notion and Confluence integrations are fixed first-party connectors, not MCP plug-ins, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
